verdict.summary: Frozen patch SHA-256 matches 62d83f217c726c2484c000bd319e8506f4dc53afdc5c3dbcc1718dbdf1cc02dd. The previous review blocker is corrected: successful hold still permits ordinary gravity; hold+soft applies soft drop; hold+hard suppresses hard drop but runs ordinary gravity; hold+hard+soft suppresses soft while running ordinary gravity. Hard-drop and timer locks end the tick without applying gravity to the spawned piece. Source matches the frozen S02 board, piece, kick, bag/queue, hold, gravity, lock-delay, input-precedence, determinism, terminal, and purity contracts. Focused verification passed 88/88 with zero failures, skips, or todos. Parent full gates were not run or claimed.

note: Raw npm test retains exactly the 51 previously retired baseline failures; no new retirement entries or skips.
